method: Continuous axial boundary-face sweeps of native STEP solids
build_direction: From original upper socket-cap face towards original lower nut face

steps.step: 01 First layer: outside cylinder, 6810 inner journal and 6704 E
06 Closing layer: OOBB plate, carrier core and N
07 Sleeve layer: inner guides and twenty outer contacts
09 First disc B over standing screws and sleeves
10 Close B and start opposite cam A
11 Second disc A over standing screws and sleeves
13 Closing layer: flat plate, carrier core and N
14b Finishing cap layer: cylinder, 6810 journal and E
15 Secure the correctly directed shaft screw
16 Guide and ring nuts at the finishing face
17 Withdraw temporary tie through the starting face
18 Load the vacated starting-face shaft nut
19 Reverse the withdrawn screw and insert from the finishing face

note: Nominal CAD solids and smooth thread envelopes. Printed fit, support of loose layers, and driver handles require a bench check.

optional_connected_ring.step: Alternative connected ring onto standing screws
